name: File Info
description: Quickly view or strip metadata (EXIF, GPS, IPTC, etc.) from selected files for privacy and cleaner sharing. Works on macOS and Windows.
author: almatkai

commands.name: show-file-info
commands.title: Show File Info
commands.description: Display metadata of the currently selected file

commands.name: clear-file-metadata
commands.title: Clear File Metadata
commands.description: Strip all embedded metadata (EXIF, GPS, IPTC, XMP, etc.) and system attributes from selected files.
